description: Linux kernel gcd.c evolution from naive Euclidean to Zhaoxiu Zeng's binary GCD with __ffs. Lessons from kernel optimization practices.
mathematical_formalization: Kernel: factor shared 2s, then iterate: if(a>b) swap; b-=a; b>>=__ffs(b). Has data-dependent swap branch.
implementation_hypothesis: Kernel prioritizes portability. Our version targets specific ISA (BMI2, AVX) for maximum throughput.
experiment_seed: Extract kernel gcd.c, compile for x86-64, compare assembly against our optimized version.
